Fist Oriona is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.
“
Leave me be. Do you know how hard it is to get some shut-eye in this place?
„
— Oriona

Involvement

Oriona can be found sleeping in the Flaming Fist barracks within the fortress, resting from the duties. If the player character wakes her up, she outrages at them about it. If the party dispatched the  thieving Flaming Fist first, Oriona comments on this, calling him useless both as a Fist and a criminal.

Oriona lacks any equipment save for the key from her personal chest.
